data.exact_reserve_text: The non-catastrophe loss ratio improved during the year to 40.7% (2020: 51.9%) as we maintained underwriting discipline, had favourable claims experience in 2021 and positive prior year development of GBP 41.7m on previously established reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels (LPT) / quota share reinsurance back
prior_year_events.impact_description: Part VII transfer and associated 100% quota share reinsurance back to the Syndicate in Dec 2020 impacted net reserves and reinsurance recoverables, benefiting 2020 and prior years in the 2021 calendar year.
2020 was heavily impacted by the unprecedented COVID-19 pandemic leading to elevated losses in 2020; 2021 experienced lower COVID-19 related losses contributing to prior year improvement.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 4444 recorded positive prior year development in 2021, driven by favourable claims experience and reduced COVID-19 related losses, together with effects from the Part VII transfer and reinsurance arrangements which benefitted 2020 and earlier years. The reported prior year improvement was approximately GBP 41.7m (released), representing around a 2.3% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: positive prior year development of GBP 41.7m on previously established reserves.
with 2020 being heavily impacted by the unprecedented Covid-19 pandemic
Despite further Covid-19 enforced restrictions in 2021 the level of losses incurred was significantly lower at GBP 12.6m (2020: GBP 73.9m)
The 2020 and prior years of account in the loss development table have the benefit of the LPT in the calendar year 2021 impacting the net reserves.
data.data_quality_notes: The report does not present an explicit GROSS single-line 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure. The GBP 41.7m prior year development figure appears in narrative (page 5) and aligns with a run-off deviation total of GBP 41.68k shown in Note 9 (net/run-off table). The figure used above is therefore a NET/overall prior-year improvement (release) rather than an explicit gross prior-year movement; gross PYD was not clearly isolated in the available notes. Additionally, the Part VII transfer (LPT) and associated quota-share reinsurance in December 2020 materially affects net reserves and distorts development tables; this reduces confidence in triangle-based gross computations.
